# SSGOI reference

Source: https://github.com/meursyphus/ssgoi/tree/HEAD/apps/docs/src/demo/instagram

Reviewed commit: 13b79f278cf15d391e08e191cd16fe3afd8f8602. Dependency: @ssgoi/react 7.4.0. Main feed navigation stays stable; photo zoom, profile-tab slide, detail drill and create/comment sheet use the persistent provider in packages/ui/src/motion.tsx. Reduced motion disables transitions. Persian RTL changes the visual reading direction. MIT attribution is preserved in ssgoi-license.txt. No Instagram marks or third-party post photos are shipped.
